name: 会話のメッセージ入力欄
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. ONE catalog component LH03-0003「会話のメッセージ入力欄」.
Reference priority: ORIGINAL Image1 bottom composer controls icon glyph geometry, proportions, stroke/optical weight, alignment, spacing and fine anatomy. Mock Image2 is secondary for Japanese copy and broad logical layout only. Do NOT copy the mock's rough substitutes.
Create one compact single-row empty chat composer on pure white #FFFFFF canvas. Original sequence left to right: slender plus; wide white pill input; INSIDE input at right a small outlined rounded sticker glyph with a folded lower-right corner exactly like ORIGINAL; outside input a compact outlined still-camera with short raised top and centered lens; outlined microphone capsule with U-shaped cradle/stem. Important correction: our mock shows a PAPERCLIP, but the original has a FOLDED STICKER glyph; use original sticker, not paperclip, smiley, chain or send arrow. Keep camera proportions and microphone detailed from original.
Inside input at left, exact Japanese placeholder:「メッセージを入力」. Native text Meiryo Regular14px/24px at logical390px width, tracking0. Input40px high, full row60px high, same quiet typographic hierarchy under uniform scale. All strokes coherent slate #526173, label subdued gray #6E6E6E. Input white with fine neutral outline and very restrained soft shadow. Crisp consistent optical weight, balanced baselines and usable spacing.
No selected, recording or submitted state is visible; therefore no decorative color accent, no green circle/button and no invented send control. Use official Lighthouse white/slate palette. Green remains brand context only.
Landscape3:1 output showing ONE full component large and centered with modest pure-white margins. No surrounding phone, title, status bar, conversation, wallpaper, keyboard, app branding, extra text, hover state, variants or duplicated components. Preserve original's complete control set and familiar refined icon silhouettes.
reviewNotes: 原画像が形状・線幅・微細配置の主参照。モックのクリップを原画像の折返しステッカー記号へ修正。生成画像を目視し、メッセージを入力、プラス、ステッカー、カメラ、マイクと完全な並び、白い入力欄・統一スレートを確認。意味ある選択状態が無いので色アクセント省略。線の厳密なベクトル同一性・フォント計測・操作・所有者承認は未検証。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
